findings.description: AWS access key ID and secret access key are stored in plain text in the Lambda function's environment variables, readable by anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration and committed to version control.

The Lambda environment variables are not encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key (no kms_key_arn set), so sensitive values rely only on the default service key and are exposed in the console/API to any principal with describe permissions.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches from AWS.
No code_signing_config_arn is attached, so the deployment package is not signature-validated and tampering between build and deployment would go undetected.
The function has no vpc_config, so it runs outside any VPC with unrestricted outbound internet access and no security-group-based egress control, providing an unmonitored exfiltration path.
